title: Chapter 49: Reversal Of The Battle Situation
content:
Chapter 49: Reversal Of The Battle Situation

On the battlefield, the bear goblin priest saw that the hydralisks were about to successfully withdraw, and immediately ordered the bear goblin infantry and lizardman light infantry in the front row to charge.

A large number of bear goblin infantry and lizardman light infantry rushed out of the formation and charged in the direction of the hydralisks.

At this time, the rocks and thorns on the ground finally played a role, and the charging speed of the bear goblin infantry and lizardman light infantry was greatly limited.

This allowed the hydralisks to retreat calmly and turn around from time to time to attack the fragile soldiers such as lizardmen.

The lizardman light infantry rushed up to deliver resources to the Zerg, and a spike from an ordinary hydralisk could make them lose their combat ability.

Some more puppies rushed up to intercept the charge of the bear goblin infantry and lizardman light infantry, which made it a luxury for them to attack the hydralisks at close range.

Seeing that it was hopeless to encircle the hydralisks, the bear goblin priest had to order the army to advance in formation to overwhelm them.

When the army of the bear goblins finally advanced to the interception line formed by the puppies, the puppies who were fighting desperately on the entire front line were suddenly trapped in the vast sea of the enemy and were completely suppressed.

At this point in the battle, there were still about 5,000 puppies fighting on the battlefield. The bear goblins wanted to completely eliminate the influence of these puppies, and they also had to pay a heavy price.

But at this point in the battle, there was no choice. If they did not attack these puppies with all their strength, these puppies would bring greater casualties to the entire army.

In the melee, the puppies' ability to adapt to the environment played a role. No matter what was under their feet or next to them, their special body structure allowed them to fight completely unaffected.

When the various arms of the bear goblin tribe faced uneven ground, hard rocks and thorns, their combat effectiveness would be affected to a certain extent.

This seemingly small difference, when accumulated continuously, would also have a great impact on the battle situation.

Looking at the puppies who were almost all thrown into the battlefield, I finally understood why Wu Qing did not let him send troops to participate in the battle. This was a typical war of attrition.

If he sent troops to the battlefield today, they would all be consumed here.

However, he also understood that there were not many tactics available to face the army of the evil god believers.

These fanatical believers who were brainwashed by the evil god had unbreakable morale and were not afraid of death. They also had the blessing of faith from time to time from the sacrifices. These were the most headaches for the native races.

No matter how well-trained and determined the soldiers of the native races were, they were also normal intelligent creatures with emotions and morale. It was normal for them to be defeated and flee by the army of the evil god believers.

Meng thought about it now. Such a war of attrition was not something that anyone could fight. If ordinary troops were pulled over to fight such a war, they would not have the strong fighting will of the Zerg. The result would be that they would be defeated and flee by the army of the bear goblins.

"Is such a war of attrition the best strategy to deal with the army of the evil god believers?"

"But who has the capital to fight such a war of attrition?"

"No wonder I subconsciously thought that the Zerg was the hope of defeating the evil god!"

Meng thought of many things at this moment.

He looked back. Since the first squad of Zerg reinforcements arrived, the subsequent squads of Zerg reinforcements arrived one after another, and soon thousands of Zerg troops were assembled.

At this speed of reinforcement, the Zerg will soon have another combat-ready army on the battlefield.

He finally understood what Wu Qing said now.

"This Zerg reinforcement is indeed very large! Can't you send more at a time?!"

Meng complained helplessly in his heart.

On the battlefield, 1,000 Hydralisks that retreated to a safe position occupied the high ground again and attacked the densely populated area of the Bugbear army.

At this time, the long-armed ogres and the Bugbear cavalry were dragged by the puppies and could no longer pose a threat to the Hydralisks. If other troops charged without sufficient numbers, they would be live targets sent to the door.

The battle situation seemed to have returned to the state that the Bugbears did not want to see.

This may be the first time that the Bugbears have encountered opponents like the Zerg. This race, like them, who are not afraid of death and cannot be defeated, is really too difficult to deal with.

The armies of other races, even if they have powerful long-range attack units, still have many ways to win the battle even if they suffer more casualties.

But this Zerg, with only a small team of long-range units, can do nothing about them.

The Hydralisks that have now retreated to a distance are calmly shooting the Lizardmen.

The army of the Bugbear tribe has no way to break through the interception of the Puppies and attack the Hydralisks.

Faced with this situation, the Bugbear priest has only one choice, which is to concentrate on killing the Puppies first.

Kill the Puppies, and then chase the Hydralisks regardless of casualties. He does not believe that the Hydralisks are perpetual motion machines that can attack continuously.

His idea is not wrong. The Hydralisks are certainly not perpetual motion machines, but such a battle still cannot consume their energy reserves, and they also have the ability to quickly replenish energy.

The fight between the Puppies and the various units of the Bugbear tribe is bloody and cruel. Fortunately, there is a systematic material-energy conversion, and the bodies of the Puppies and the enemies cannot be seen. Only the dying wounded soldiers are lying on the ground.

The difference in the strength of the two sides was too great. No matter how fierce and good at fighting, the puppy was useless. It was gradually surrounded and killed by the army of the bugbears.

The losses of the bugbears were also huge. There were not many long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry left after the frenzy. The bugbears and lizardmen infantry also suffered heavy losses.

Especially the Lizardmen light infantry, under the special care of the Hydralisks, suffered serious casualties, but fortunately their total number was large enough, so the impact was not great for the time being.

On the battlefield, the Zerg's forces only had 1,000 Hydralisks and the puppies guarding them. Of course, there were also the Tiger Cavalry led by Wu Qing and Meng, but they were a little far from the current battlefield.

The long-armed ogres and bear goblin cavalry, who were in a frenzy, killed all the puppies around them and rushed towards the Hydralisks. They could not maintain their current state, so they had to seize the time to fight quickly.

If there were no Zerg reinforcements as Wu Qing said, the outcome of this war would be very clear. The Zerg could not create miracles in the face of the evil god believer army with an absolute advantage in manpower. They were not strong enough and would lose.

But the Zerg had reinforcements, and they were continuous reinforcements.

Meng looked back again at the large group of puppies behind him and the Zerg teams that were still rushing to join him. He knew that there was no suspense in this war.

Thinking of the expressions of the priests of the Bugbear tribe after seeing the Zerg reinforcements, Meng couldn't help but smile on his tiger face.

"First I'll let you see the hope of victory, then I'll crush your hope. You arrogant followers of the evil god, you will also have this day!"

"Haha!"

Meng couldn't help but laugh out loud.

Wu Qing looked at Meng's smile and knew that he was completely relieved at this time.

The Zerg with just over 10,000 people fought with the Bugbear tribe like this. What if there were another 10,000 or 20,000?

The ending is of course needless to say.

The situation of the battle has been reversed!
